title: MAML initialization with Mirror-only inner-loop adaptation
hypothesis: On few-shot linear task families whose task weights lie on a known two-angle rotation orbit, a first-order MAML-trained shared prototype adapted only through two Mirror angles will match full first-order MAML query error within 25%, use fewer actual inference payload bytes than full task vectors, and outperform byte-near rank-2 LoRA; if native Givens-angle conditioning or rank-2 LoRA reproduces it at matched budgets, there is no Mirror-specific benefit.
physical_object: one shared six-dimensional linear predictor prototype, meta-trained over task episodes
mirror_coordinate: m=(angle_a,angle_b) optimized by support-set gradients; two fixed Givens rotations act on coefficient pairs (0,1) and (2,3)
logical_multiplicity: held-out few-shot linear predictors for independently sampled task angles
controls: first-order MAML adaptation of all six coefficients
learned rank-2 additive LoRA basis with two adapted coefficients
native Givens-angle-conditioned predictor (exact functional alias control)
independent fitted six-coefficient task vectors (upper/storage control)

task.type: six-dimensional linear regression; each task target is generated by applying two Givens rotations to a fixed coefficient template plus Gaussian observation noise sigma=0.02
task.outer_algorithm: first-order MAML across disjoint training task identities

development.selection_metric: mean held-out query RMSE after four support updates; same generated tasks for all methods

paid_objects: per-task full vectors or adapted codes
method identifier and shape/dtype schema metadata
storage.note: All arrays and metadata are serialized into the measured archive; no task support examples are stored.

gates.PROMISING: Both development seeds: Mirror query RMSE <=1.25x full MAML; Mirror bank payload <=0.70x full MAML; Mirror query RMSE at least 10% lower than rank-2 LoRA at no more than 1.25x LoRA bytes and 1.25x end-to-end adaptation + query wall time; native Givens control must not be byte/hash/output identical.
gates.FAIL: Either seed misses the full-MAML quality or byte gate, or Mirror is within 5% quality of the matched native Givens/rank-2 control with <=5% payload difference, or end-to-end adaptation + query runtime exceeds 1.25x the relevant control.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Independent full MAML cannot reach query RMSE 0.08 or less on both development seeds, or implementation/serialization replay is invalid.

boundaries: Synthetic aligned linear-regression mechanism screen only; no neural-backbone, language, natural-task, or deployment claim.
First-order MAML is used rather than second-order MAML; task support/update budget is equal across adaptive methods.
The Givens native conditioner intentionally tests representation alias, not a Mirror-branded baseline.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless both development seeds pass all success gates.

amendments.reason: The first development artifacts included support adaptation time in the metric labeled inference_wall_s and copied meta-training counts onto the no-adapt/independent controls. This is an accounting-label defect; model settings, data, byte payloads and quality metrics are unchanged.
changes: Report adaptation_wall_s separately from query-only inference_wall_s and their sum as end_to_end_wall_s.
Report zero meta-training updates/examples for no-adapt and independent-fit controls; count their support examples and least-squares compute separately.
Separate training and evaluation active-operation proxies, count both in the reported total, and report no meta-training operations for non-meta-trained controls.
